PreprocessingCandidate.description: Candidate produced from a reviewed Preprocessing package.
PreprocessingCandidate.title: PreprocessingCandidate

StudentUploadCandidate.description: Candidate produced from a student's own upload.
StudentUploadCandidate.title: StudentUploadCandidate

QuestionAggregate.description:
The full record of one logical question.

``revisions`` is append-only. ``instances`` lists every known
occurrence. ``state_history`` preserves every approval/publication event
so rule 9 (history preserved) is structural, not a convention.
QuestionAggregate.title: QuestionAggregate

AnswerAssetRef.description: Reference to one image asset taking part in an answer.
AnswerAssetRef.title: AnswerAssetRef

AnswerEvidenceKind.description:
How the answer evidence was declared upstream.

Mirrors the real Preprocessing ``answer_evidence.type`` values so a
Strict Adapter can map without re-interpreting semantics. The three
cases in the Strict boundary table are:

* ``ANSWER_LINES``        — declared, direct map.
* ``ANSWER_TABLE_ROW``    — structured answer table with explicit
                             question-number → answer mapping; allowed
                             deterministic conversion, row evidence kept.
* ``INLINE_IN_EXPLANATION`` / ``RANGE_STRING`` / ``ABSENT`` — no
                             reliable per-question attribution outside
                             the declared lines; anything the adapter
                             cannot attribute becomes ``incomplete``.
AnswerEvidenceKind.title: AnswerEvidenceKind

AnswerStatement.description:
One source-anchored answer statement (the Answer Item carrier).

``value_text`` is what the source actually wrote (verbatim) or a
labelled derivation (``compressed``/``combined``/``descriptive``);
``form`` makes the difference explicit.  Conflict versions each get
their own statement so no source wording is lost or adjudicated.
AnswerStatement.title: AnswerStatement

Asset.description:
An image, chart, formula-render or other binary/content artifact.

``target_path`` links the asset to the field it illustrates; several
assets may share a target (multi-figure material) and one asset may be
referenced from several targets (shared material).
Asset.title: Asset

AssetSlot.description: One blank slot whose answer value is one or more images.
AssetSlot.title: AssetSlot

BBox.description: Axis-aligned region in a page's coordinate space.
BBox.title: BBox

CandidateCore.description:
Everything a candidate carries regardless of source.

Permission / ownership facts (``owner_scope``, ``pii_status``,
``distribution_policy``) deliberately live on the **source branch**,
not here: each source owns its own permission truth, and duplicating it
here created the F3 contradiction class. Visibility of individual
fields (answer / explanation / evidence) stays here because it is
per-field policy, not source-level ownership.
CandidateCore.title: CandidateCore

ChemicalAnswer.description: Chemical formula or equation, e.g. ``VO2+`` or ``Fe-2e-=Fe2+``.
ChemicalAnswer.title: ChemicalAnswer

CompositeAnswer.description:
Answers of a composite question, keyed by sub-question label.

Parent-level answers must not be flattened into one string: each
sub-question keeps its own typed answer and its own evidence.
CompositeAnswer.title: CompositeAnswer

CompositeSubAnswer.description: Answer belonging to one sub-question of a composite parent.
CompositeSubAnswer.title: CompositeSubAnswer

ConflictResolution.description: How a conflict among evidence records was (or was not) settled.
ConflictResolution.title: ConflictResolution

DistributionPolicy.description:
Redistribution policy for the *source material* (PDF, images).

This is deliberately separate from question publication: publishing a
question never grants the right to redistribute the teacher's PDF.
DistributionPolicy.title: DistributionPolicy

EvidenceBundle.description: All evidence for one document, kept append-only.
EvidenceBundle.title: EvidenceBundle

EvidenceConflict.description:
A recorded disagreement between evidence records.

Conflicts are first-class: they are never silently dropped and never
resolved by "latest write wins". The resolution field records *how* the
disagreement was settled, and ``resolved_by`` must be present whenever
the resolution is anything other than ``unresolved``.
EvidenceConflict.title: EvidenceConflict

EvidenceRecord.description: One piece of evidence for one target field.
EvidenceRecord.title: EvidenceRecord

EvidenceStatus.description: Lifecycle of an individual evidence record.
EvidenceStatus.title: EvidenceStatus

ExpressionAnswer.description: Mathematical expression or formula. Not evaluated by the contract.
ExpressionAnswer.title: ExpressionAnswer

IngestionIdentity.description:
Identity of one logical source object + one run that imported it.

N5: at least one input hash is mandatory — an ingestion with no
verifiable input identity is not traceable and not idempotent.
IngestionIdentity.title: IngestionIdentity

InputHashes.description:
Content hashes of the artifacts an ingestion consumed.

At least one hash must be present: an ingestion with no identity is not
idempotent and must be rejected by the importer.
InputHashes.title: InputHashes

Material.description: Shared reading material / stimulus used by a composite question.
Material.title: Material

MaterialRef.description: Pointer to shared material used by one or more questions.
MaterialRef.title: MaterialRef

MultiStepAnswer.description: A worked solution with ordered steps.
MultiStepAnswer.title: MultiStepAnswer

OwnerScope.description: Ownership / tenancy boundary for a candidate or question.
OwnerScope.title: OwnerScope

PreprocessingSource.description: Source branch: teacher-edition paper already reviewed upstream.
PreprocessingSource.title: PreprocessingSource

PreprocessingUnitRef.description:
One source unit from the upstream manifest.

Kept as a faithful *reference* to what upstream declared. The adapter
maps this into a question payload; it must not reinterpret it.
PreprocessingUnitRef.title: PreprocessingUnitRef

QuestionBody.description:
The stem / options / materials of one question (or sub-question).

``parent_question_ref`` is the structural link for composite questions:
a sub-question points at its parent's ``local_id``. Cycles and
self-references are rejected.
QuestionBody.title: QuestionBody

QuestionContent.description:
A full question payload: bodies + materials + assets.

The composite tree lives in ``bodies`` via ``parent_question_ref`` /
``sub_question_ids``. Flattening for display is a view concern; the
stored form keeps the tree.
QuestionContent.title: QuestionContent

QuestionType.description:
Canonical question taxonomy.

Covers the types observed across real Preprocessing manifests
(single/multi choice, true/false, fill-in, short answer, cloze,
grammar fill, reading, seven-to-five) plus the forms the direction
document requires the model to hold (numeric, expression, chemical,
multi-step).

``composite`` / ``standalone`` are **Unit Type** concepts (organizational
structure), never Question Type (QCORE-DELIVERY-01-C-R5 cleanup): a
composite Unit is ONE Question whose internal sub-questions live in the
``QuestionContent`` body tree (``parent_question_ref`` /
``sub_question_ids``), each keeping its own real answer-form type.
QuestionType.title: QuestionType

SlotBinding.description: Blank identity: binds ``answer_value[i]`` to a printed blank slot.
SlotBinding.title: SlotBinding

SourceDocumentRef.description:
Reference to one source artifact of a preprocessing package.

``content_hash`` is mandatory: an unhashed source is not traceable and
must not enter the formal bank. ``locator_uri`` is informational; the
contract layer never opens it.
SourceDocumentRef.title: SourceDocumentRef

SourceKind.description: Where a piece of evidence or content originated.
SourceKind.title: SourceKind

SourceLocator.description:
A position inside a source document.

Line numbers are 1-based inclusive, matching the Preprocessing manifests.
``page`` is 1-based when the source is a PDF. ``bbox`` is
``[x0, y0, x1, y1]`` in the PDF's own coordinate space when known.
SourceLocator.title: SourceLocator

SourceRef.description: Identity of a source artifact an evidence record points into.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

StrictAnswerDeclaration.description:
How upstream declared this question's answer.

This is the contract-level encoding of the Strict boundary table:

==============================  =========================================
upstream situation              strict handling
==============================  =========================================
Manifest declares the unit's    direct map
answer evidence
Structured answer table with    deterministic conversion allowed;
explicit number→answer map      table-row evidence kept
Only a whole answer table or    ``incomplete``; do NOT infer
prose explanation
==============================  =========================================

``attribution`` records which of the three cases applied. The adapter is
forbidden from producing ``DECLARED`` or ``TABLE_ROW`` when the input did
not actually declare it — that is the "no new semantic judgment" rule.
StrictAnswerDeclaration.title: StrictAnswerDeclaration

TableBlock.description:
A table with explicit row/column structure.

``cells`` is the authoritative representation; ``rows`` is the plain-text
projection (row → column → text) kept for cheap consumers. The two must
agree: every non-merged position appears exactly once.
TableBlock.title: TableBlock

TableCell.description:
One table cell.

Merged cells are expressed on the *anchor* cell via ``rowspan`` /
``colspan``; the covered positions must be omitted from the row arrays.
A cell may carry rich content, not only plain text.
TableCell.title: TableCell

UnitType.description: Structural role of a source unit in a paper.
UnitType.title: UnitType

Visibility.description:
Who may read a field's content.

``review_only`` is what makes "unpublished is not unreadable" work:
review staff see the full content while students see nothing until
publication plus the per-field visibility policy allows it.
Visibility.title: Visibility

OcrObservation.description:
One OCR/NLP observation from a student upload.

Student uploads have no reviewed manifest. Everything the pipeline saw
is an *observation* with a confidence, not a declaration.
OcrObservation.title: OcrObservation

StudentUploadSource.description:
Source branch: a student's own practice material.

F3 permission rules: student uploads are personal data. They never
default to (and cannot claim) ``public_bank`` scope — promotion to the
public bank is an explicit later action, not an import side effect.
PII defaults to ``suspected`` (a photo of homework may contain names)
and distribution defaults to ``no_redistribution``.
StudentUploadSource.title: StudentUploadSource

ApprovalRecord.description: A reviewer's approval, bound to one exact revision.
ApprovalRecord.title: ApprovalRecord

PublicationRecord.description: A publication event, bound to one exact approved revision.
PublicationRecord.title: PublicationRecord

QuestionIdentity.description: Stable identity of a logical question.
QuestionIdentity.title: QuestionIdentity

QuestionInstance.description: One occurrence of a question inside one paper.
QuestionInstance.title: QuestionInstance

Revision.description: One immutable content version of a question.
Revision.title: Revision

StateSnapshot.description:
The three-dimensional state of one Revision.

``completeness``, ``review`` and ``publication`` are stored and
validated together so the cross-axis rules can be checked in one place.
StateSnapshot.title: StateSnapshot
